dependency: Task 188 runner output, port 8012 eighteen-row proof and GitHub remote readback must exist before any Task 197 automation or queue contract is created.
geometry_policy: No new coordinates, polygons, building footprints or parcel boundaries are created or inferred. Every selected row remains NOT_BOUND.

features.name: Greenwich Peninsula
features.official_source_evidence: The official Greenwich Peninsula site documents homes to buy and rent, offices and co-working, retail opportunities, food and drink, public spaces and a creative district spread across multiple buildings.
features.classification_finding: Mixed-use character is strongly supported, but Greenwich Peninsula is a broad neighbourhood and masterplan rather than one Mixed Building. A named building or defensible parcel must be selected before geometry binding.

features.name: Royal Arsenal Riverside
features.official_source_evidence: Berkeley Group identifies Royal Arsenal Riverside as a multi-phase Woolwich development with numerous named residential phases, apartments, amenities and a published site plan.
features.classification_finding: The development identity is authoritative, but the tracked entity is a multi-building residential-led estate rather than one Mixed Building. A named phase or building must be selected before exact geometry binding.

features.name: Elephant Park
features.official_source_evidence: The official Elephant Park site presents the destination through shop, eat, live and work functions, confirming mixed residential and commercial use.
features.classification_finding: Mixed-use character is supported, but Elephant Park is a neighbourhood containing multiple buildings and public spaces. One named building or parcel is required before geometry binding.

features.name: Blickling Estate
features.official_source_evidence: The National Trust identifies Blickling as a historic house and estate in Norfolk, with the principal house forming only part of the wider visitor property.
features.classification_finding: The historic-house identity is strong, but the tracked estate includes gardens, parkland and visitor functions. The principal house must be isolated and the Detached Home taxonomy reviewed.

features.name: Brindleyplace Birmingham
features.official_source_evidence: The official Brindleyplace site describes a Birmingham estate combining office buildings, restaurants, bars, shops, cultural attractions, hotel and public realm.
features.classification_finding: Mixed-use estate classification is supported, but Brindleyplace is not one building. A specific building or defensible estate parcel must be selected before geometry binding.

features.name: Paradise Birmingham
features.official_source_evidence: The official Paradise Birmingham site documents workspace, food and retail space, hospitality, residential accommodation, leisure uses and multiple named buildings across the estate.
features.classification_finding: Mixed-use character is strongly supported, but Paradise is a multi-building city-centre estate. A named building or exact parcel must be selected before geometry binding.
